Bring the signed-in FPO admin's page to the front. The first call of a run opens a headless Chromium and signs +919000000001 in through the login form (mobile, dev OTP, then the PIN step; a fresh seed has no PIN yet, so the form chooses 1234). Later calls reuse that page, so a run spends one admin OTP (the API allows 10 per phone per day). Tests call it before their API fixtures: the API sign-in (`Login As`) can wait out the one-code-per-60 s limit, the form cannot. Fails: a sign-in step is not reached within the Browser timeout, or an earlier test's sign-in failed (no retry: each attempt would spend another OTP). Side effects: sets the suite variable ${ADMIN_PAGE}; on a fresh seed sets the admin's PIN.

Bring the signed-in FPO admin's page to the front. The first call of a run opens a headless Chromium and signs +919000000001 in through the login form (mobile, dev OTP, then the PIN step; a fresh seed has no PIN yet, so the form chooses 1234). Later calls reuse that page, so a run spends one admin OTP (the API allows 10 per phone per day). Tests call it before their API fixtures: the API sign-in (`Login As`) can wait out the one-code-per-60 s limit, the form cannot. Fails: a sign-in step is not reached within the Browser timeout, or an earlier test's sign-in failed (no retry: each attempt would spend another OTP). Bring the signed-in FPO admin's page to the front. The first call of a run opens a headless Chromium and signs +919000000001 in through the login form (mobile, dev OTP, then the PIN step; a fresh seed has no PIN yet, so the form chooses 1234). Later calls reuse that page, so a run spends one admin OTP (the API allows 10 per phone per day). Tests call it before their API fixtures: the API sign-in (`Login As`) can wait out the one-code-per-60 s limit, the form cannot. Fails: a sign-in step is not reached within the Browser timeout, or an earlier test's sign-in failed (no retry: each attempt would spend another OTP). Side effects: sets the suite variable page=46e8d6e0-acec-4b10-80c8-7b0c9fcbc98b; on a fresh seed sets the admin's PIN.

Bring the signed-in FPO admin's page to the front. The first call of a run opens a headless Chromium and signs +919000000001 in through the login form (mobile, dev OTP, then the PIN step; a fresh seed has no PIN yet, so the form chooses 1234). Later calls reuse that page, so a run spends one admin OTP (the API allows 10 per phone per day). Tests call it before their API fixtures: the API sign-in (`Login As`) can wait out the one-code-per-60 s limit, the form cannot. Fails: a sign-in step is not reached within the Browser timeout, or an earlier test's sign-in failed (no retry: each attempt would spend another OTP). Side effects: sets the suite variable page=46e8d6e0-acec-4b10-80c8-7b0c9fcbc98b; on a fresh seed sets the admin's PIN.

Bring the signed-in FPO admin's page to the front. The first call of a run opens a headless Chromium and signs +919000000001 in through the login form (mobile, dev OTP, then the PIN step; a fresh seed has no PIN yet, so the form chooses 1234). Later calls reuse that page, so a run spends one admin OTP (the API allows 10 per phone per day). Tests call it before their API fixtures: the API sign-in (`Login As`) can wait out the one-code-per-60 s limit, the form cannot. Fails: a sign-in step is not reached within the Browser timeout, or an earlier test's sign-in failed (no retry: each attempt would spend another OTP). Side effects: sets the suite variable page=46e8d6e0-acec-4b10-80c8-7b0c9fcbc98b; on a fresh seed sets the admin's PIN.

kw.arg: iframe[title^="Preview of the public page"] >>> body
kw.doc: Returns text attribute of the element found by ``selector``.

Load batch X's page and assert on the text of its public-page preview iframe. Args: ${operator} a Browser assertion operator (contains, not contains); ${text} the text. Fails: the preview does not match within the Browser timeout.
Runs the specified keyword and retries if it fails.

kw.name: Set FPO Farmer Names
Portal Database
Get Variable Value
kw.doc: Returns variable value or `default` if the variable does not exist.

kw.name: Connect To AgriTrace Database
kw.doc: Open a DatabaseLibrary connection to the stack's Postgres/PostGIS using pg8000. Fails: database unreachable or credentials wrong. Side effects: one open connection for the suite; close it with Disconnect From Database.

kw.name: Query
kw.arg: SELECT f.public_show_farmer_names FROM fpos f JOIN memberships m ON m.fpo_id = f.id JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE u.phone = '${ADMIN}'
kw.doc: Runs a query with the ``select_statement`` and returns the result as list of rows. The type of row values depends on the database module - usually they are tuples or tuple-like objects.

kw.name: Set Suite Variable
kw.doc: Makes the variable available everywhere within the scope of the current suite.

kw.name: Set Suite Variable
kw.doc: Makes the variable available everywhere within the scope of the current suite.

Connect to the stack's database once per run (the P06/P08 fixture switches have no API) and remember the FPO's farmer-name setting so the teardown can restore it. Fails: the database is unreachable. Side effects: sets True and true.

kw.name: Execute Sql String
kw.msg:
Executing sql:
UPDATE fpos SET public_show_farmer_names = false WHERE id IN (SELECT m.fpo_id FROM memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE u.phone = '+919000000001')
kw.arg: UPDATE fpos SET public_show_farmer_names = ${value} WHERE id IN (SELECT m.fpo_id FROM memberships m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE u.phone = '${ADMIN}')
kw.doc: Executes the ``sql_string`` - as a single SQL command (default) or as separate statements.
Set the admin's FPO `public_show_farmer_names` in the database (no API route changes it; the Settings switch is read-only). Args: ${value} true | false. Side effects: UPDATE fpos.

kw.name: Rebuild And Wait
Call Api
kw.doc: Call the live API as a user and optionally assert the status.

kw.name: Evaluate
kw.doc: Evaluates the given expression in Python and returns the result.

kw.name: Click
kw.doc: Simulates mouse click on the element found by ``selector``.

kw.name: Wait For Build
kw.doc: Wait until page build ``build_no`` of a batch leaves ``queued`` (the worker builds it).

kw.name: Should Be Equal
kw.doc: Fails if the given objects are unequal.

On the batch page of batch X press "Rebuild" and wait until the worker has built the new page build (GET /v1/batches/{id}/builds). Fails: the build is not `built`. Side effects: one page build; the preview reloads with it.

suite.doc: FPO admin portal acceptance (plan §7.3 P01-P08) and the P07 chain. Serves: FR-8, FR-9, FR-12, FR-13, FR-14, FR-15, FR-23, FR-25, FR-29, FR-37, FR-41, FR-46, FR-49, FR-58, FR-70; gate G4; WP Q07 (P01-P04 lines real). Run by: Q02 Verifier, gate G4. Needs `rfbrowser init` once and the portal served in live mode (`npm run dev`, no VITE_MSW) against the stack under test; see qa/robot/README.md. Every test drives the UI as the seeded FPO admin, signed in once per run through the login form. Data the line needs (farmers, plots, packed lots, QC grading) is made over the API with the agritrace_keywords fixtures; API reads only back up what the screen showed (the stored status, the audit row, the QR content). Ready lots is opened with a full page load, because the portal caches lots and hold flags for 30 s and each test makes its lots just before. Placeholders are tagged not-ready and skip until their WP merges.

suite.doc: Public batch page: render, privacy lint, HTML validity, size budgets, Lighthouse thresholds, backend-down serve (plan §7.4 W01-W03, §7.5 Q03). Serves: FR-5, FR-15, FR-16, FR-17, FR-19, FR-41, FR-58, FR-61, FR-63; gate G4; BM-03, BM-09, BM-16. Run by: W02 and Q03 Verifiers. Needs uv (builds fixtures/batch_sample.json into apps/public-page/out/site) and, for the html-validate and Lighthouse tests, `npm ci` in apps/public-page. Lighthouse tests are tagged needs-chrome and skip when lhci finds no Chrome (set CHROME_PATH). The W03 Tamil font test needs `rfbrowser init` (Browser library). The two Q03 tests (WP Q07 round 2) need the live stack: API_BASE, PUBLIC_BASE_URL and COMPOSE (they stop and restart its api and worker). Placeholders are tagged not-ready and skip until their WP merges.

The live-stack form of apps/api/tests/e2e/test_reference_batch.py (WP Q07 round 2): the same seed, flag set, refused gates and fixes, over the API of the stack under test. The gate lines change the seeded batch, so the "before fixes" lines need a fresh seed: on a stack where the batch is already published they skip with that reason. "Dart And TS Clients Compile" needs node_modules in apps/portal, Java 11+ and dart on PATH.
